paraphrase: Paul reports that, at a Jerusalem meeting fourteen years later (2.1; the reference point is disputed), James, Cephas and John, 'reputed to be pillars', recognised the grace given to him and gave him and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, and that the one who worked through Peter (identified with Cephas on the usual reading) for the apostleship of the circumcision worked through Paul for the Gentiles. Textual report of Peter's standing in the Jerusalem community within Paul's lifetime; it does not report any commission by Jesus, and it names Cephas second of three.
